response.sql: WITH invoice_metrics AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) as avg_line_product_cost, SUM(derived_total_cost) / SUM(product_price) as ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as overall_avg_ratio FROM invoice_metrics) SELECT AVG(im.avg_line_product_cost) as avg_line_product_cost, AVG(im.ratio) as avg_ratio, AVG(im.ratio) - oar.overall_avg_ratio as ratio_exceeds_overall_average FROM invoice_metrics im CROSS JOIN overall_avg_ratio oar WHERE im.ratio > oar.overall_avg_ratio

assumptions.assumption: No invoices have all NULL or zero-summing product_price values. The ratio calculation (SUM(derived_total_cost) / SUM(product_price)) produces a valid numeric result for each invoice.
